prior_exposure.lp-v1: lp-v1 read the whole year and released join-leg mark-outs at 10 minutes before the off and fill counts.
prior_exposure.movement-v1: movement-v1 read the whole year and released taker NCLV by decision time with intervals and SDs; on the lab it also gave means by price band, field size and late-move cell, and raw tick quantiles.
prior_exposure.p0: The whole 2015-16 PRO year counts as inspected from P0's first run, which started two variants; their outcome metrics stay on the lab.
prior_exposure.suite-counts: Whole-year counts of in-play markets and of markets with a removed runner are known; they are counts, not locations.
